nl: Convert orders.json (an array of objects) to export/orders-3.csv with the columns customer, total, status in this order, a header line and one line per order, without quotes.
oracle_program: read "orders.json" |> select customer total status |> write "export/orders-3.csv" format: csv parents: true
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os
os.makedirs('export', exist_ok=True)
rows = json.load(open('orders.json'))
cols = ['customer', 'total', 'status']
with open('export/orders-3.csv', 'w') as f:
    f.write(','.join(cols) + '\n')
    for r in rows:
        f.write(','.join(str(r[c]) for c in cols) + '\n')
EOF
reference_pwsh:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force export | Out-Null
Get-Content orders.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object customer,total,status | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation -UseQuotes Never | Set-Content export/orders-3.csv
